subject: Post-call: LumenFlow POC scope & accountability — next steps
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lina Torres <lina@lumenflow.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@lumenflow.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: LumenFlow POC scope & accountability — next steps

Hi Lina / Samir —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before we lock the POC dates. I captured items from the discovery and the parts that need ownership on both sides.

POC objective (agreed):
- Verify 2 core Redwood inference flows in LumenFlow: real-time summarization for alerts (<= 250ms p50 target) and nightly bulk embedding pipeline (throughput target: ~200k records / hour).

Success criteria (measurable):
- Summarization: latency p50 < 300ms, p95 < 800ms with merged batching, quality pass rate >= 85% on the provided 200-case prompt set.
- Embeddings: throughput >= 150k/hr, average cost per 1k tokens within +/-15% of our initial estimate.
- No production data leaves LumenFlow VPC during the POC; keys are customer-managed.

Proposed timeline:
- Week 0 (this week): finalize mutual action plan and access scope.
- Week 1–2: infra hookup + test dataset ingestion.
- Week 3: performance validation & run quality evals.
- Week 4: demo + decision review.

RACI (high-level):
- Redwood infra provisioning (dedicated POOL, network): Ben Carter — R/A.
- Customer VPC peering / firewall rules: LumenFlow infra (Samir) — R/A.
- App integration (+ SDK & routing): Karthik Iyer (SE) — R.
- Security evidence & KMS config: Monica Patel (security) — A/R for proving compliance.
- Procurement / SOW sign-off: Lina (LumenFlow) + Priya for Redwood commercial — C.

Action items (owners):
- Priya: send updated MAP (attached) and draft SOW — action by EOD tomorrow.
- Ben: prepare a resource plan for the dedicated pool and a brief checklist of network rules we need.
- Karthik: draft a lightweight test harness to run the latency/throughput checks locally and share on the Drive.
- Monica: list required evidence and minimal audit items for a short SOC-alike review.

Attachments: LF-MAP-mutual-action-plan.xlsx (first draft), lumenflow-sample-data-inventory.csv (sample schema)

Open questions from call:
1) Will LumenFlow be able to stand up a temporary KMS key for the POC or prefer Redwood-managed? (security constraint)
2) Any compliance constraints for storing embeddings beyond POC window?

Lina — if you can confirm the procurement window (targeted by end of month?) and whether Samir’s team can give the network contact for peering, we’ll slot dates next week.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priya@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: LF-MAP-mutual-action-plan.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: LumenFlow POC scope & accountability — next steps

Thanks Priya — good summary. I’ll own the dedicated capacity planning and will call out exact GPU SKU options and expected throughput. Quick clarifications from my side:

- For the latency p50 target: we should confirm expected payload size and average prompt length; I’ll assume 256 tokens for planning. If customers plan to send longer contexts we’ll need a different kernel profile.
- Networking: we need a single CIDR range and the remote IP(s) for the NAT/proxy. Samir — please confirm the egress IPs the infra team will open.

Initial deliverables I’ll produce:
1) Capacity plan (SKUs, memory, expected concurrent sessions) — due Fri 18 Sep.
2) Network allowlist + minimal security checklist for VPC peering — due Tue 22 Sep.

Karthik — can you confirm the test harness interface you’ll expose (simple HTTP /batch endpoint + sample runner)? If you want, I can add a short script to exercise batching at target concurrency.

Monica — for KMS, if LumenFlow requires customer-managed keys we’ll need steps for key rotation/perms. If we do Redwood-managed but inside their VPC, it changes the compliance boundary — let’s call this out in the MAP.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Dedicated Solutions | Redwood Inference
Attachment: none

From: Lina Torres <lina@lumenflow.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@lumenflow.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: LumenFlow POC scope & accountability — next steps

Hi Priya — thanks for the detailed recap. Confirming a few items from LumenFlow side: we can target end-of-month procurement but need a small internal review first (legal + infra). Samir’s team can provide the egress IPs by tomorrow.

On KMS: our security team prefers customer-managed keys, but we can stand up a temporary key for the POC and share access with Redwood via IAM roles. We cannot export keys outside our KMS. Accepted.

We will:
- Share sample dataset (anonymized) and the schema by EOD Thu (attached).
- Confirm procurement window by 21 Sep.

We reviewed the success criteria and are comfortable with the proposed targets; one ask — can Redwood provide a short write-up on the quality evaluation method you’ll run for summarization? (metrics and accept/reject examples).

Lina Torres
Director of Product | LumenFlow
Attachment: lumenflow-sample-data-inventory.csv (csv)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Lina Torres <lina@lumenflow.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: LumenFlow POC scope & accountability — next steps

All — thanks for the quick responses. I’ve updated the mutual action plan in Drive (link below) with the clarified owners and deadlines. Short version:

- Ben: Capacity plan + network checklist (due 18 Sep).
- Karthik: Test harness + evaluation harness doc (quality method + sample pass/fail) — due 20 Sep.
- Monica: Compliance evidence list + KMS instructions for customer-managed key flow — due 20 Sep.
- Lina / Samir: sample data + egress IPs (LumenFlow) — due 17 Sep.
- Priya: commercial SOW draft and procurement timeline check-in — due 21 Sep.

Next steps: I’ll sync with Grace (CS lead) and schedule the kick-off call for Mon 21 Sep (30–45m) once Samir confirms network contacts. Please review the MAP in Drive and add any missing items directly in the spreadsheet.

Drive (updated): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cPOCdocs
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/DEAL-78910

If there are any blockers (procurement, key policy, or data export limits) flag them here and I’ll escalate to Grace.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachment: LF-MAP-mutual-action-plan.xlsx (updated)
